items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I see that you’re a composer, you can go from playing a Nat King Cole standard into your very adventurous compositions.

ctx.x: I see that you’re a composer, you can go from playing a Nat King Cole standard into your very adventurous compositions. What inspires you to write?

Man, that’s tough because it’s so many different things, it’s not like one answer for that. You know, I write all the time. I write, again depending on moods, depending on emotion, depending on who I’m talking to, my inspiration comes from everything. From people, from stories, from you know watching certain movies or hearing certain soundtracks or hearing certain songs or hearing certain, you know, sounds you know, out in the world. Like you hear a dog bark or something like that and you’ll be like man that…
